name: Sky Carrier Bridge (boss arena)
prompt: A WIDE 16:9 landscape backdrop for the BOSS ARENA of a 2.5D beat-'em-up: the open command bridge / forward flight-deck of a colossal FLYING AIRCRAFT CARRIER, seen side-on so the deck runs left-to-right. Dramatic: the towering island superstructure with the glowing lit BRIDGE windows looms large on one side, radar arrays and antenna masts against a moody dusk sky streaked with orange and violet, heavy storm clouds massing behind, warning lights blinking on the deck edge, yellow hazard chevrons on the steel plating. Higher stakes / final-showdown mood. Gritty indie-arcade / dark-comic HD cel-shaded, strong rim light. NO characters, NO UI, NO frame — the environment only, full-bleed.
cardartAction: a dramatic side-on shot of the bridge tower over the deck at dusk, storm clouds and beacon lights, the deck running across the frame

name: Far Cloud Band (parallax)
prompt: A WIDE 16:9 horizontal band of DRIFTING CLOUDS against clear high-altitude sky, for a parallax background layer in a sky-set beat-'em-up. Layered cumulus catching warm daylight, soft depth haze, plenty of open blue between the clumps so it reads as a distant layer. Painterly HD cel-shaded to match a dark-comic game. NO ground, NO ship, NO characters, NO frame — just a clean, seamless-feeling cloud band that can scroll horizontally.
cardartAction: a wide serene band of sunlit clouds drifting across an open sky, distant and soft
